app.academy.tutorial.page.fusion.body.1:
Drop an entire matching batch into Imag Phase fluid and keep it submerged.
After 10 ticks: 1 clay ball becomes 1 polymer; 36 iron nuggets become 1 metal ingot.
app.academy.tutorial.page.fusion.body.2:
After 40 ticks: 4 diamonds or 4 emeralds become 1 Imag Phase crystal.
The same live rules power JEI's Imag Phase World Fusion category.

app.academy.tutorial.page.route.body.1:
01 Find an Imag Phase lake with a probe or by mining and exploring.
02 Build a Solar Generator and Ability Control Tablet, charge it, then develop an ability and learn skills.
03 Open the Data Terminal with Right Alt and initialize P.R.O.P.S.
app.academy.tutorial.page.route.body.2:
04 Press V for the skill HUD; Up/Down changes the selected skill and C casts it.
05 At Level 5, press Backslash to open the custom ability-program editor.
app.academy.tutorial.page.route.brief: Five checkpoints take you from first materials to a programmable Level 5 ability.
app.academy.tutorial.page.route.preview:
Follow the entries in order.
Recipe pages remain available at any time.
app.academy.tutorial.page.route.title: From first lake to Level 5
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.1.body.1:
Craft the Imag Phase Probe and right-click it. It scans only loaded chunks, up to a 12-chunk radius.
If no target is reported, travel to load new terrain and scan again; mining and cave exploration can also reveal a lake directly.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.1.body.2:
Use the lake itself to make starter materials: submerge 1 clay ball for polymer, 36 iron nuggets for an ingot, or 4 diamonds/emeralds for a crystal.
Wait for the whole matching batch to convert before retrieving it.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.1.brief: Find an Imag Phase lake, then use its world-fusion rules to make the first Academy materials.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.1.preview:
TARGET
Imag Phase fluid

PROBE RANGE
Loaded chunks, up to 12
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.1.title: Locate Imag Phase
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.2.body.1: Craft a Solar Generator and place it beneath open sky. Put the Ability Control Tablet in the generator's charging slot; sunny daylight is fastest, rain is weaker, and night produces no power.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.2.body.2:
When the tablet has energy, hold it and right-click. Use the development interface to obtain an ability category and learn visible skills.
Both development and learning consume stored Academy energy.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.2.brief: Generate energy, charge the portable developer, then develop and learn your ability.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.2.preview:
POWER PATH
Sunlight > Solar Generator
> charging slot > Tablet
> ability development
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.2.title: Power and ability development
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.3.body.1: Press Right Alt to open the projected Data Terminal. Settings changes general and system bindings; Skill Settings shows learned-skill descriptions, their active bindings and per-skill options.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.3.body.2:
Open P.R.O.P.S and enter start once. The system then pre-develops five ability factors through normal play, including movement, combat, experience, crafting/mining, first kills and structure discovery.
Exact acquisition ratios follow the group's pinned reference; the coefficient falls as the total approaches 2000.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.3.brief: Use terminal apps for descriptions and bindings, then initialize the pre-development system.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.3.preview:
DEFAULT KEY
Right Alt

P.R.O.P.S CONSOLE
command: start
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.3.title: Data Terminal and P.R.O.P.S
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.4.body.1: Press V to toggle the Skill HUD. The right-hand wheel lists learned skills that currently have an active binding and shows those bindings under each skill name.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.4.body.2:
Press Up or Down to move the selection. Press or release C to route the corresponding phase to the selected skill for quick casting.
Individual skill bindings continue to work and can be edited in Skill Settings.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.4.brief: Expose learned skill bindings, select one from the HUD and cast it through a shared key.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.4.preview:
V  toggle HUD
Up/Down  select
C  cast selected
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.4.title: Operate the Skill HUD
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.5.body.1: After reaching Level 5 in a supported ability category, press Backslash (the key above Enter on common layouts) to open the custom ability-program editor.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.5.body.2:
Build and validate a program graph, then store executable programs in its slots.
The default execution bindings are Alt+1 through Alt+0 and can be changed from the Data Terminal.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.5.brief: Level 5 unlocks programmable ability graphs and ten quick-execution slots.
app.academy.tutorial.page.step.5.preview:

skill.academy.defensive_teleport.profici: Projectiles lose their original target and retain 50% speed at destination; creatures receive 3 seconds of Slowness.
skill.academy.dir_strike.desc: Drive a circular 12-block kinetic shock through the ground, damaging hostile targets and lifting nearby terrain as a render-only wave.
skill.academy.dir_strike.proficiency.200: Effective radius rises from 12 to 14 blocks.
skill.academy.dir_strike.proficiency.300: Targets within 4 blocks are pressed down and take a second 40% hit after 6 ticks without extra block damage.
skill.academy.disarm.desc: Scan 16 blocks along the crosshair, teleport an item out of the first hittable living target, and deal skill damage.
skill.academy.disarm.proficiency.2000: Range increases from 16 to 20 blocks and both hands may be processed; the second item costs another 100% base cost.
skill.academy.disarm.proficiency.3000: Disarmed items enter a 5-second spatial cache and cannot be reclaimed; afterward they drop at the target's original position and cannot be kept by the caster.
skill.academy.disintegrate.desc: Fire a special particle beam for 20% of maximum health. A kill scatters up to three beams; secondary kills scatter once more without further chaining.
skill.academy.disintegrate.proficiency.2: Range +20%, and first-kill scatter limit increases from 3 to 4.
skill.academy.disintegrate.proficiency.3: Surviving targets are Disintegrated for 5 seconds, reducing effective armor by 25%, or 12.5% for players; chain depth is unchanged.
skill.academy.electrical_contact.desc: Reserve 15 CP to shock nearby enemies periodically and return an attributed electrical shock to hostile melee attackers.
skill.academy.electrical_contact.profici: Trigger radius increases from 2 to 3 blocks and interval falls from 40 to 30 ticks.
Retaliation marks the attacker for 4 seconds; the next electrical hit chains 50% damage to one enemy within 4 blocks.
skill.academy.electromagnetic_shield.des: Absorb incoming damage into an electromagnetic barrier that cools by consuming CP.
skill.academy.electromagnetic_shield.pro: Shield capacity +25% and cooling rate increases from 10 to 15 per tick.
A full overload emits a 4-block pulse applying Slowness II and Weakness I for 2 seconds, with a 10-second cooldown.
skill.academy.endurance_training.desc: Increase endurance by 50 per proficiency tier.
skill.academy.flashing.desc: Press H to enable the skill, then press W/A/S/D to flash up to 8 blocks in that movement direction. Obstructions shorten the flash to the nearest safe point along the path, as with Self Teleport; press H again to disable it.
skill.academy.flashing.proficiency.2000: The client directional-input interval falls from 6 to 4 ticks; the server minimum remains 2 ticks and maximum flash distance stays at 8 blocks.
skill.academy.flashing.proficiency.3000: Queues up to 3 consecutive W/A/S/D inputs before the previous flash finishes; every flash is independently validated and charged.
skill.academy.flesh_ripping.desc: Hold Alt+Right Mouse to lock a living target within 64 blocks, then release to deal 12 plus 5% maximum-health spatial damage.
The lock persists for 10 ticks after briefly losing sight.
Applies Spatial Laceration for 5 seconds, reducing effective armor by 20% and received healing by 25%; values are halved for players.
skill.academy.flight.desc: Toggle slow creative-style flight. Hovering costs no compressed air; only movement consumes it, and reaching zero does not toggle the skill off.
skill.academy.flow_sense.desc: Toggle awareness of nearby living creatures through atmospheric disturbances, including invisible targets; sneaking players normally remain hidden.
skill.academy.flow_sense.proficiency.100: Sensing radius increases from 24 to 32 blocks.
skill.academy.flow_sense.proficiency.200: Refresh interval falls from 10 to 5 ticks and the sync limit rises from 64 to 96 targets.
skill.academy.flow_sense.proficiency.300: Even sneaking players can no longer hide their atmospheric disturbance.
skill.academy.high_speed_jet.desc: Hold the install key to preview a block face with a white border or an entity with a white silhouette; installed targets remain highlighted until their nozzle is removed. Entity nozzles face you and propel only their host away from you when fired. Owned nozzles within 64 blocks can be fired remotely, and overlapping block jets stack acceleration.
skill.academy.high_speed_jet.proficiency: The loaded nozzle limit increases from 8 to 12.
Jet duration increases from 40 to 60 ticks.
skill.academy.impression_manipulation.de: Suppress natural aggression in compatible controlled targets, allowing only self-defense, defense of their controller, and target misidentification while reserving CP.
skill.academy.impression_manipulation.pr: Default reservation per target falls from 10 to 9 CP.
Default reservation per target reaches 8 CP; guard-target switching responds 50% faster. (Not yet implemented)
Roster members attacking the same authorized target gain 10% attack and movement speed, fading 3 seconds after disengaging; damage is unchanged.
skill.academy.iron_sand_arsenal.desc: Reserve 50 CP to orbit iron sand, repel nearby hostiles, and sweep a 120-degree forward sector when swinging your main hand.
skill.academy.iron_sand_arsenal.proficie: Whip hits mark targets for 4 seconds; close defense consumes the mark for +50% whip damage and pulls frontal targets.
skill.academy.jet_strike.desc: Dash toward a safe point eight blocks ahead and damage creatures around the destination.
skill.academy.jet_strike.proficiency.200: Maximum dash distance increases from 8 to 10 blocks and impact radius +20%.
skill.academy.jet_strike.proficiency.300: Leaves a 10-tick particle wake; first contact deals 40% ordinary impact damage once per target.
skill.academy.kinetic_energy_applied.des: Reserve computing power to strengthen movement and attacks. Left-click impacts entities or blocks, while an air swing releases the impact forward. Cycle strength from 1 to 6 and toggle block destruction separately.
skill.academy.kinetic_energy_applied.pro: Impact-wave radius +15% at every level; block-processing radius is unchanged.
A 30% aftershock follows direct impacts after 6 ticks, once per target per second.
skill.academy.laminar_buffer.desc: Hold to charge: tap toggles slow falling, stronger jumps, and airborne momentum retention; half charge holds your altitude temporarily; full charge creates a compressed-air foothold below you.
skill.academy.laminar_buffer.proficiency: The sustained laminar effect is shared with allied creatures within 16 blocks.
Half-charge hover duration increases from 3 to 5 seconds.
Compressed-air footholds last 15 seconds instead of 10.
skill.academy.laminar_cutter.desc: Hold to charge a shield-piercing air blade: half charge widens it, greatly increases knockback, and breaks fragile blocks; full charge bypasses armor and ravages equipment durability.
skill.academy.laminar_cutter.proficiency: Blade length +20%; a full-charge hit also disarms the target, subject to equipment-control protection.
Hits reduce effective armor for 5 seconds by 20%, or 10% against players.
skill.academy.light_shield.desc: Hold to project a visible shield and gain Resistance II while periodic pulses repel and damage nearby hostile mobs.
skill.academy.light_shield.proficiency.2: Radius increases from 3.5 to 4.5 blocks and knockback +20%.
skill.academy.light_shield.proficiency.3: Destroys hostile projectiles in range and restores 2 CP each, up to 10 CP/s; indestructible projectiles are only slowed.
skill.academy.lightning_nova.desc: Release a visible expanding electrical ring that damages targets as the wavefront crosses them.
skill.academy.lightning_nova.proficiency: After reaching maximum radius, an inward echo deals 50% damage; each target can be hit once by each wave.
skill.academy.lightning_storm.desc: Call twenty-one lightning strikes around the target in your line of sight.
skill.academy.lightning_storm.proficienc: Storm radius increases from 8 to 10 blocks and target range +20%.
Every third pulse prefers an enemy not yet struck by the storm.
skill.academy.location_teleport.desc: Save up to 32 named locations and teleport safely between dimensions.
skill.academy.location_teleport.proficie: Saved-location limit increases from 32 to 48; grouping by dimension is supported. (Not yet implemented)
Within 5 seconds, cast the same saved-location entry again in the Location Teleport screen to return once for 50% of the first actual cost.
skill.academy.magnet_manipulation.desc: Hold while aiming at an iron-bearing block or entity to pull yourself toward it. Hold Shift to pull the target in front of you.
skill.academy.magnet_manipulation.profic: Releasing throws the target; collision damage scales with speed up to 12, excluding bosses. (Not yet implemented)
skill.academy.magnetic_weapon.desc: Toggle while holding a sword to reserve 40 CP; the floating blade attacks threats within 16 blocks every 10 ticks and returns.
skill.academy.magnetic_weapon.proficienc: Target range increases from 16 to 20 blocks and attack interval falls from 10 to 8 ticks.
Every 20 ticks, intercepts one frontal hostile projectile and counters its source.
skill.academy.mental_intervention.desc: Add the living entity in sight, including an eligible player, to the controlled roster; use it again to release that target.
skill.academy.mental_intervention.profic: Cast cost -10%, and selection range increases from 16 to 20 blocks.
Selection range increases from 20 to 24 blocks.
Adding a non-player may also add up to 2 compatible same-type creatures within 4 blocks, each independently charged and protection-checked.
skill.academy.mental_intrusion.desc: Continuously observe the living entity in sight without moving or controlling it while reserving CP.
skill.academy.mental_intrusion.proficien: Maximum session distance increases from 96 to 128 blocks and persists beyond normal selection range.
The view shows health, armor, major effects, and held items; maximum player observation duration +50%, still limited by cooldown.
skill.academy.mental_stupor.desc: Toggle a lasting suppression of movement and actions for compatible controlled targets while reserving CP.
Default reservation per target falls from 10 to 9 CP.
Default reservation per target reaches 8 CP; boss and player cost multipliers are unchanged.
After 3 seconds, non-player targets enter deep stupor and cannot jump, sprint, or continuously use items.
skill.academy.mental_takeover.desc: While intruding into a rostered target, continuously control its movement, view, and attacks; eligible players gain break-free points at double efficiency with WASD or either mouse button.
skill.academy.mental_takeover.proficienc: Session reservation falls from 100 to 90 CP.
The unified break-free rule no longer uses the old slowdown modifier; true damage still interrupts immediately under the original rule.
Unlocks server-validated offhand use and hotbar switching, at most once per second; containers, item dropping, and inventory editing remain blocked.
skill.academy.mind_destruction.desc: Locks the first entity in a 64-block line of sight and deals 1% of maximum health + 10 mental damage each second for 10 seconds. Targets in the Mental Intervention roster also receive an attempted 10-second stupor; targets outside it take damage only. Mental defenses and break-free resistance block only the stupor, not the damage.
skill.academy.mind_destruction.proficien: Cast cost falls from 100 to 90 CP.
skill.academy.mine_detect.desc: Reserve CP to reveal nearby ore blocks in already loaded chunks.
skill.academy.mine_detect.proficiency.20: Detection radius increases from 64 to 80 blocks and scan budget +50%.
skill.academy.mine_detect.proficiency.30: Loaded ore blocks are grouped into veins and shown with size, distance, and highest-value ore. (Not yet implemented)
skill.academy.mining_beam.desc: Hold to bore through breakable blocks and damage entities along a 48-block beam.
skill.academy.mining_beam.proficiency.20: Range increases from 48 to 56 blocks and breaking radius +20%.
skill.academy.mining_beam.proficiency.30: Unlocks Harvest Mode in Advanced Skill Settings: Auto Smelt, Fortune III, or Silk Touch. Auto Smelt obeys the server proficiency policy.
skill.academy.multiple_brain_domain_segm: Increase every skill's stack limit by the current proficiency tier.
skill.academy.output_control.desc: Hold Tab to regulate ability output, movement speed bonuses, and jump-height bonuses. Only damaging skills and their separately paid attack CP are affected; upkeep, ceiling reservations, and Precision Operation are not. At 0.01 / 1 / 2 output, attack CP costs 0.1 / 1 / 4 times normal, with diminishing changes near both limits.
skill.academy.parallel_thought_computati: Increase CP iteration speed by 5% per proficiency tier.
skill.academy.particle_wave_cannon.desc: Hold to charge a wide 85-block beam that continuously destroys blocks and damages marked targets.
skill.academy.particle_wave_cannon.profi: Maximum range increases from 85 to 96 blocks and beam width +15%.
Radiation-marked targets remain irradiated for 3 seconds after leaving, taking 20% ordinary pulse damage each second without refreshing the mark.
skill.academy.physical_training.desc: Increase muscle strength and dexterity by 25 per proficiency tier.
skill.academy.piercing_teleportation.des: Hold Alt+R to preview the nearest safe position beyond the first blocking block within 40 blocks, or the 40-block point if unobstructed. Scrolling switches to free adjustment from the displayed position, allowing any safe destination within 64 blocks, including one before a wall; release to teleport.
skill.academy.piercing_teleportation.pro: Base range is now 64 blocks; no additional effect is configured for this tier. (Not yet implemented)
Retains 50% horizontal momentum on arrival and prevents wall-collision damage from it for 10 ticks.
skill.academy.plasma_generation.desc: Gather a visible plasma core above the caster, then launch a server-targeted destructive blast after at least three seconds of charging.
skill.academy.plasma_generation.proficie: Minimum charge falls from 3 to 2.4 seconds and explosion radius +10%.
Leaves a 5-second plasma zone dealing 8% ordinary explosion damage each second, without executions or true damage.
skill.academy.platinum_wing.desc: Ascend beyond White Wing; normal attacks retain the true-health fan strike, while sneaking attacks execute a crosshair target up to 128 blocks away.
Execution preparation and cooldown -20%; range is unchanged.
Unexecutable bosses instead take capped ordinary skill damage equal to 15% maximum health.
skill.academy.pneumatic_grasp.desc: Hold to pull or push items, experience, projectiles, and hostile mobs, consuming 10 CP and 2 compressed air every 10 ticks while a target is controlled.
skill.academy.pneumatic_grasp.proficienc: Heavy-target response +20%; controlled projectiles retain their original speed cap.
Can control grounded non-boss mobs at 50% force for an additional 5 CP and 2 compressed air every 5 ticks.
skill.academy.precision_operation.desc: Press \ to open the Precision Operation editor and configure up to 10 program slots; press Alt+1..0 to run the corresponding slot.
skill.academy.precision_operation.profic: All per-target continuous reservations inside programs -10%.
Across 2 or more active slots, duplicate perception/path nodes for a shared target are charged once to the earliest-started slot.
Unlocks one bounded acyclic conditional branch by health ratio, distance, target type, or status effect; node and execution budgets are unchanged.
skill.academy.quick_location_teleport.de: Send the entity under your crosshair, or yourself, to the selected saved location.
skill.academy.quick_location_teleport.pr: Moves the target's root vehicle and passenger hierarchy as one unit; per-member safety validation and rejecting the entire unpaid operation on failure are pending. (Not yet implemented)
skill.academy.radiation_intensify.desc: Electron-beam hits mark targets for ten seconds; later beam hits deal 50% more damage.
skill.academy.radiation_intensify.profic: Mark duration increases from 10 to 12 seconds.
Subsequent beam damage bonus increases from 50% to 60%, affecting only ordinary damage.
When a marked target dies, copies its remaining duration to up to 3 enemies within 5 blocks without dealing damage.
skill.academy.railgun.desc: Charge and fire a destructive electromagnetic shot using a coin, iron ingot, iron block, anvil, or nearby thrown coin.
skill.academy.railgun.proficiency.1000: Final cast cost -10%, and charging cost -10%.
skill.academy.railgun.proficiency.2000: Range +20%; the shot penetrates the first entity and deals 60% damage to the next.
skill.academy.railgun.proficiency.3000: Impact creates a 4-block non-terrain shockwave dealing 25% primary damage and knockback.
skill.academy.reflection_filter.desc: Configure which status effects may pass through Vector Deviation/Reflection by mode, whitelist, and blacklist.
skill.academy.reflection_filter.proficie: Dynamic CP cost for filtered harmful effects -15%.
Returns half the remaining duration at the original amplifier to a valid applier, once every 5 seconds per applier.
The first harmful effect every 10 seconds is fully reflected at no extra cost; boss sources are only intercepted.
skill.academy.rejecting_wind.desc: Burst the surrounding atmosphere in an 8-block radius: charging raises damage and launches targets upward; full charge adds levitation and reduced air resistance.
skill.academy.rejecting_wind.proficiency: Burst radius increases from 8 to 10 blocks.
Slowness, levitation, and reduced-drag durations increase by 50%.
Horizontal rejection force increases by 20%, and full-charge reduced drag lasts 20 ticks longer.
skill.academy.scatter_bomb.desc: Charge and release seven delayed electron beams, each dealing base damage plus one percent of the target's maximum health.
skill.academy.scatter_bomb.proficiency.2: Charge time for the same beam count -20%, and maximum beam count increases from 7 to 8.
skill.academy.scatter_bomb.proficiency.3: Before forming, a missed beam may redirect once toward the nearest radiation-marked target within 8 blocks.
skill.academy.self_teleport.desc: Hold R and scroll to set a distance up to 64 blocks (40 by default), then release to teleport to a collision-safe position before the first blocking block or nearer.
Base range is now 64 blocks; no additional effect is configured for this tier. (Not yet implemented)
Within 3 seconds of arrival, stay crouched and fully hold then release R again to return for 50% of the first actual cost; unsafe origins reject the return.
skill.academy.sensory_distortion.desc: Selects the entity under the crosshair using Mental Intervention's sight and range rules, then hides the caster from its sight, targeting, perception memories, rendering, and direct interactions while reserving CP; use again to stop the current effect.
skill.academy.sensory_distortion.profici: Also suppresses ordinary footsteps, game-event vibrations, and non-attack particles; damage and block interaction still reveal the caster.
Leaving a target's sight creates a 3-second false afterimage for natural targeting; explicit attack targets are not misled.
skill.academy.shackle.desc: Hold Ctrl to preview the first hittable living target within 32 blocks, then shackle it for 5 seconds and deal skill damage.
skill.academy.shackle.proficiency.2000: Imprisonment for non-player targets increases from 8 to 10 seconds; players remain at 8 seconds.
skill.academy.shackle.proficiency.3000: A target forcibly moved over 2 blocks while shackled returns to its anchor and takes 40% secondary damage, once per imprisonment.
skill.academy.single_high_speed_electron: Fire a delayed electron beam from a randomized origin; aim improves with proficiency, close-range origin spread tightens automatically, and maximum proficiency hits along the crosshair direction.
The beam continues through the first creature once, dealing 60% ordinary damage to the second target; maximum-health damage does not penetrate.
skill.academy.space_folding_theorem.desc: Increase compatible Teleport skill damage by 25%.
skill.academy.space_folding_theorem.prof: Compatible spatial damage multiplier increases from 1.25 to 1.30.
The multiplier reaches 1.35, and self-movement skill distance +10%.
The multiplier reaches 1.40; spatial-damage kills refund 20% of that attack's actual cost, at most once every 3 seconds.
skill.academy.spacial_excision.desc: Spend 100 CP to enter a 30-second spatial-cut state. Same-dimension self-teleports leave fissures that damage creatures in a 3×3 corridor, pull non-allied creatures from a 7×7 corridor, and heavily strike creatures near the path during their first second.
skill.academy.spacial_excision.proficien: No proficiency enhancement; the spatial-cut state remains unchanged.
No proficiency enhancement; the spatial-cut state remains unchanged.
No proficiency enhancement; the spatial-cut state remains unchanged.
skill.academy.spatial_synergy.desc: While enabled, Self Teleport, Penetrate Teleport, and Location Teleport carry same-team players within 4 blocks.
skill.academy.spatial_synergy.proficienc: Default maintenance reservation falls from 20 to 18 CP.
Carry radius increases from 4 to 6 blocks.
Also carries nearby allied or tamed non-player living entities, excluding passengers; each additional entity adds 10 CP temporary cost.
skill.academy.storm_wing.desc: Sustain vector flight; steer with movement keys and hold Space for high-speed propulsion.
skill.academy.storm_wing.proficiency.200: Steering response and high-speed thrust cap +15%.
skill.academy.storm_wing.proficiency.300: High-speed flight leaves a 2-second wake that propels allies and slows hostile projectiles by 40%.
skill.academy.tailwind_field.desc: Hold to charge a flow field: tap places a directional current, half charge makes it follow your facing, and full charge makes the following field flow outward.
skill.academy.tailwind_field.proficiency: Placed and following field durations increase by 25%.
Flow acceleration increases from 0.22 to 0.26 per field tick.
skill.academy.target_misidentification.d: Permanently force every compatible controlled mob to mistake the selected living entity for an enemy; select it again to release the effect.
skill.academy.target_misidentification.p: False-target range increases from 64 to 80 blocks; batch application delay is halved. (Not yet implemented)
When the false target dies, roster members retarget the nearest valid enemy within 8 blocks once; otherwise the effect ends.
skill.academy.threatening_teleport.desc: Hold to select a target, then release to teleport one main-hand item into it and deal damage. Without a locked creature, the item drops 16 blocks forward along your line of sight.
skill.academy.threatening_teleport.profi: Living-target lock range is now 64 blocks; no additional effect is configured for this tier. (Not yet implemented)
Generated item entities return to the caster's inventory if uncollected for 3 seconds; if full, they drop at the caster's feet.
skill.academy.thunder_lance.desc: Fire a Thunder Lance along your line of sight, attacking targets across a 32-block path.
Range increases from 32 to 40 blocks and spear width +20%.
Targets hit by at least 2 arcs chain 40% damage to the nearest enemy within 6 blocks.
skill.academy.thunderclap.desc: Call down lightning at the target in your line of sight, damaging nearby creatures based on maximum health.
skill.academy.thunderclap.proficiency.20: Target range increases from 64 to 80 blocks and blast radius from 5 to 6 blocks.
skill.academy.thunderclap.proficiency.30: Applies Slowness IV and Weakness II for 3 seconds, halved against bosses and players.
skill.academy.turbulent_cavitation.desc: Toggle this effect at no cost. While enabled, Aeromanipulation-attributed displacement abrades living targets each tick according to actual distance traveled, bypassing armor and heavily damaging worn equipment.
skill.academy.turbulent_cavitation.profi: Armor-bypassing damage per traveled block increases from 1 to 2.
Armor durability damage per traveled block increases from 12 to 18.
Per-tick accountable distance increases from 3 to 4 blocks, with higher damage and durability caps.
skill.academy.vacuum_domain.desc: Toggle a 50-block vacuum around yourself. Hostile creatures capable of drowning rapidly lose air and then take armor-piercing maximum-health damage.
Air depletion per pulse increases from 40 to 60.
Vacuum radius expands from 50 to 100 blocks.
skill.academy.vector_accel.desc: Charge a server-authorized vector dash; longer charging increases speed and the trajectory preview shows the collision path.
skill.academy.vector_accel.proficiency.2: Charge time needed for the same speed -25%.
skill.academy.vector_accel.proficiency.3: The first enemy collision deals 6 scaled skill damage, knocks it forward, and preserves 50% dash speed.
skill.academy.vector_blast.desc: Project a 64-block vector blast that damages targets along its path. Crossing the Abyss adds an area of true damage ahead.
skill.academy.vector_blast.proficiency.2: Range rises from 64 to 72 blocks and impact width +20%.
skill.academy.vector_blast.proficiency.3: Creates a 3-block endpoint burst for 40% ordinary main damage without copying special damage.
skill.academy.vector_deviation.desc: Maintain a deviation membrane that reduces or completely deflects damage and may deflect projectiles.
skill.academy.vector_deviation.proficien: Negated damage occupies CP at ×1 of processed damage.
Negated damage occupies CP at ×0.5 of processed damage.
Iteration interval decreases from 10 to 5 ticks; deflectable damage below 1% of maximum CP has no dynamic cost.
skill.academy.vector_reflection.desc: Maintain a reflection membrane that reflects damage and projectiles.
skill.academy.vector_reflection.proficie: Reflected damage occupies CP at ×1 of processed damage.
Reflected damage occupies CP at ×0.5 of processed damage.
Iteration interval decreases from 10 to 5 ticks; reflectable damage below 1% of maximum CP has no dynamic cost.
skill.academy.vortex_pull.desc: Cast instantly to pull nearby entities once toward an aimed point; half charge sustains the vortex, and full charge expands its range and force.
skill.academy.vortex_pull.proficiency.30: Stores up to 16 unowned or hostile projectiles and releases them along your view at 75% speed when the vortex ends.
skill.academy.white_wing.desc: Upgrade Black Wing into its white form while retaining vector flight and the 32-block true-health fan attack.
skill.academy.white_wing.proficiency.200: Deflects one frontal hostile projectile within 6 blocks every 20 ticks without reflecting damage.
skill.academy.white_wing.proficiency.300: Each valid sweep target restores 3 CP, capped at 15 CP per sweep; true-health damage is unchanged.
